Name: DE-ProjectsClassifications
Statement:
select  pcl.Oid as ProjectClassificationId,
        pcl.Name as ProjectClassification,
        pcl.Active,
        pcl.Billable,
        pcl.Code,
        pcl.[Default],
        c.Name as Company,
        c.HasImage as CompanyHasImage,
        c.Oid as CompanyId
from    ProjectClassification pcl
            left join Company c on c.Oid = pcl.Company
